spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पिशति)
1 To be decomposed, to be reduced to constituent parts.
2 To be organised.
3 To enlighten, to light.

r. 7th cl. (पिषष्टि)
To grind, to pound, to bruise or powder.
r. 10th cl. (पेषयति)
1 To injure.
2 To give.
3 To be strong.
4 To dwell.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (पेषति पेषयति)
To go or move.

(ऋ) पिसृ r. 1st cl. (पेसति)
To go or move.
r. 10th cl. (पेसयति)
1 To go.
2 To be strong.
3 To injure or hurt.
4 To give.
5 To dwell.
(इ) पिसि r. 10th cl. (पिंसयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
3 To destroy.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Of a tawny or brown colour.
m. (-ङ्गः)
Tawny, (the colour.)
E.
पिश to be a component part, अङ्गच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Tawniness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, पिशङ्गत्व.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
Brown, tawny.
E.
पिशङ्ग, and इनि aff.

m. (-चः)
A sprite, a fiend, a malevolent being something between an infernal imp and a ghost, but always described as fierce and malignant.
f. (-ची)
A female imp, a she demon.
E.
पिश for पिशित flesh, and अश to eat, aff. अण्, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, पिशाचक, पिशाचिका.

m. (-की)
KUVERA, the god of wealth.
E.
पिशाच a demon, इनि aff., and कुक् augment; the treasures of this deity being guarded by Piśācas, and other malignant beings.

m. (-द्रुः)
A tree, (Trophis aspera.)
E.
पिशाच a goblin, and द्रु a tree; the favourite haunt of these beings.

m. (-क्षः)
The Śākhoṭa tree: see the last.
E.
पिशाच, and वृक्ष a tree.

n. (-भं)
1 An assemblage of goblins or fiends.
2 The place or hall of their assembly, pandemonium.
E.
पिशाच a goblin, and सभा assembly, but neuter in this compound.

n. (-तं)
Flesh.
f. (-ता)
Spikenard.
E.
पिश to be a component part, part. aff. क्त.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Eating meat.
m. (-नः)
A demon, a fiend, a cannibal.
E.
पिशित, and अशन food.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Eating flesh or meat, carnivorous.
m. (-शी)
A goblin, a cannibal.
E.
पिशित, and अश to eat, aff. घिणुन्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Cruel, wicked.
2 Vile, low, contemptible.
3 Stupid, a fool.
n. (-नं)
Saffron.
m. (-नः)
1 A spy, an informer.
2 A name of

NĀRADA.
3

A crow.
4 Cotton.
f. (-ना)
A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
पिश to be a part, उनन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel unchanged.

n. (-नं)
Evil speech, abuse, detraction, slander.
E.
पिशुन, and वचन speech.

n. (-क्यं)
Evil speech, bad report, detraction, slander.
E.
पिशुन, and वाक्य speech.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Ground, pounded, bruised.
2 Clasped, (as the hands,) squeezed, rubbed together.
3 Kneaded.
n. (-ष्टं)
1

Lead.
2

The flour or meal of any thing that is ground.
E.
पिष to pound or bruise, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A cake made of the flour or meal of any grain.
2 A disease of the eyes, opacity of the cornea.
n. (-कं)
Oilcake.
E.
पिष्ट what is pounded, कन् aff.

mn. (-पः-पं)
A world, a division of the universe.
E.
पिश to go, अप् Uṇādi aff., and टन् augment; also पिष्टप.

n. (-नं)
A boiler, a seether, a sauce-pan.
E.
पिष्ट meal, &c. and पचन cooking.

m. (-शुः)
A type or effigy of a victim, made with flour.
E.
पिष्ट, and पशु an animal.

m. (-भृत्)
A boiler.
E.
विष्ट meal, पाक cooking, and भृत् what makes.

n. (-कं)
A boiler.
E.
पिष्ट, and पाचक what cooks.

n. (-रं)
Meal, made up into a sort of cake with clarified butter.
E.
पिष्ट meal, and पॄ to complete, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of meal or flour, &c.
E.
पिष्ट that which is ground, and मयट् transformative aff.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
A small cake, made of barley, rice or pulse ground to meal.
E.
पिष्ट meal, and वृत to be, and इञ् aff.

n. (-भं)
Sandal.
E.
पिष्ट ground, and सौरभ fragrant.

m. (-तः)
Perfumed powder, for scenting rooms, garments, &c. especially the scented dust, which the Hindus sprinkle over each other at the Holī or spring festival.
E.
पिष्ट pounded, (saffron, &c.) and अत to go or be, aff. अच्.

n. (-कं)
A cake made of rice flour.
f. (-का)
The meal of pulse steeped in water, peeled and ground.
E.
पिष्ट ground, ठक् aff.
